#MessiInIndia | Mumbai Police has issued a traffic advisory ahead of football icon Lionel Messi’s appearance at Wankhede Stadium on December 14 as part of the Goat India Tour 2025. Authorities have warned of heavy congestion in and around South Mumbai, with road diversions and parking restrictions planned near Colaba, Marine Drive and adjoining areas. 

Commuters have been advised to plan their travel in advance, use public transport where possible, avoid private vehicles and strictly follow police instructions to ensure smooth traffic movement and public safety.

#Messi #MessiInIndiaTour #LionelMessi #MessiTour #GoatIndiaTour
